spatial_structure.zh: 一条双向证据脊、三带叠合、三核六站、两翼互馈
spatial_structure.en: one bidirectional evidence spine, three overlapping belts, three anchors, six stations and two reciprocal wings

core_innovation.zh: 证据南行，纠错北返；更正回到每个受影响渠道，并反向触发重测、采购更新与产品修订。
core_innovation.en: Evidence moves south and corrections return north; each correction reaches every affected channel and triggers retesting, procurement updates and product revision.

three_belts.role: heritage provenance, public memory and creator rights
screenless daily services, health, education and public correction
testing, incubation, procurement and risk evidence

three_key_areas.zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
three_key_areas.en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Independent Innovation Acceleration Area
three_key_areas.program: Failure Evidence Yard: evaluation, public observation, isolation, repair and retest
Civic Review Hall: screenless intake, evidence translation, independent review and correction return
Reversible Adoption Hall: procurement, lifecycle cost, exit testing and screenless recovery

two_wings.function: global factor allocation, Zhongguancun IP and capital enablement
AI scenario enablement and an AI-vital city

brand_and_long_term_operation.identity: J/Z switchback + evidence-southbound and correction-northbound arrows
brand_and_long_term_operation.cultural_line: from engineering log to open-source log

phases.gate: official spatial data and engineering feasibility
independent impact evaluation and statutory approvals

operating_model.decision_rule: high-impact adverse decisions require two-person review and a documented appeal
operating_model.revenue: service contracts, training, evaluation fees and grants; core public screenless service remains free
